# Draft:Heritage Pageants

----
Heritage Pageants is an international cultural pageant event that has been reported by media outlets in Asia, Africa, and Europe. The event includes national and international competitions under titles such as Miss Heritage International and Mrs Heritage International.
Media coverage indicates that Heritage Pageants events have been held in multiple countries. According to MyRepublica, international editions of Heritage Pageants were organized in Thailand, with participation from delegates representing several nations. The outlet also reported on Nepal’s participation in various editions of the event, including national selections and international finals.
In Kenya, The Standard reported on the Mrs Heritage International finals held in Nairobi, where national winners were crowned to represent the country at the international level.
Coverage in Nigeria by Blueprint and People’s Daily highlighted participation by Nigerian representatives at Miss Heritage International events and related public appearances.
Other international media, including QazInform, The Himalayan Times, and The Times of India, have reported on winners and contestants associated with Heritage Pageants in countries such as Kazakhstan, Nepal, and India.
